persons.name: Rakṣamāna
persons.evidence: lakṣamānasya pustakaṃ ... uṃkhācuka vajrācārya śrīrakṣamānaṃ na[[thavata arthana]] coyā juro

date.as_written: naipārābde gataitāni grahasvādasāgarā, māsa .. vaiśāṣe śukre, ⟪trita⟫tṛtīyāpracatuṣṭake || rohinyāṃ yogaśobhāgya, guruvāra samūke

purpose: thavata arthana (svārtha, for his own purpose/use)
notes: The chronogram 'grahasvādasāgarā' represents 469 (graha = 9, svāda = 6, sāgara = 4; read in reverse order). The name is spelled both Rakṣamāna and Lakṣamāna (in 'lakṣamānasya pustakaṃ').
